WHO WE ARE

Pakistan's halal meat, prepared for the world's tables

Founded on 7 January 2026 and headquartered in Lahore, HSP Meat Exporter supplies beef, mutton, goat meat, camel meat, and edible offal — fresh, chilled, and frozen — to importers, wholesalers, retailers, hotels, and distributors across the Gulf.

Livestock is sourced from our own operations and trusted markets, processed under Halal, HACCP, and ISO 22000 standards, and moved through a temperature-controlled cold chain from the farm gate to the port.

OUR STORY

Built on quality, from the ground up

Founded on 7 January 2026 and headquartered in Lahore, Pakistan, HSP Meat Exporter is a premium supplier of halal meat, dedicated to serving international markets with exceptional quality, integrity, and reliability.

We specialize in the export of beef, mutton, goat meat, camel meat, and edible offal in fresh, chilled, and frozen forms — serving importers, wholesalers, retailers, hotels, restaurants, and distributors across the Gulf region.

Livestock is sourced through our own operations and carefully selected, trusted markets, then handled through approved partner slaughterhouses with strict oversight from sourcing and halal processing to packaging and export.

Our Mission

To deliver premium halal meat products that meet international standards through uncompromising quality, food safety, and dependable export services.

Our Vision

To become a trusted global supplier of premium halal meat by expanding our presence across the GCC, Asia, and international markets — making high-quality halal products more accessible worldwide.
